reviews.author: Danny Kargar
reviews.text: We visited this Japanese restaurant on Saturday and, unfortunately, the service really let the experience down. The person who welcomed us when we arrived was very friendly and polite, which was a great first impression. However, the girl who took our order was quite rude and made us feel uncomfortable. The person who brought our food also had a very unpleasant attitude. What concerned us the most was the hygiene. While bringing food to our table, as well as serving other tables, the staff member repeatedly scratched himself. This was very off-putting and, in my opinion, is not appropriate when handling and serving food. The food itself was actually okay and we had no major complaints about the quality. However, when we visited on Saturday, we also wanted to order cocktails, but they didn't even have vodka available to make them, which was disappointing for a Saturday evening. Overall, the food was decent, but the service, attitude of some staff members, and especially the hygiene standards really need improvement. Unfortunately, these issues had a big impact on our overall experience.

reviews.text: I deeply regret choosing your restaurant. The quality of the food was terrible. The female waitress who took our order was extremely rude and showed no respect towards the customers. What was even more disturbing was the male waiter who was serving the food. His hygiene was absolutely unacceptable. On two separate occasions, I saw him serving food to the table next to mine while he had his hand down the back of his trousers, scratching his backside. It was honestly disgusting and completely inappropriate, especially for someone handling and serving food. Although the restaurant itself appeared clean, the male waiter serving the food seemed to have no understanding of basic hygiene standards. I strongly urge the restaurant manager or owner to review the CCTV footage from 20:24 to 20:35 on Saturday, 26 September 2026. You should be able to clearly see what I witnessed, including the waiter putting his hand inside the back of his underwear and scratching himself while working. Overall, the entire experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

reviews.text: Probably applies to takeaway only. Hate to give bad reviews but I think this one is deserved. I asked if I could get extra tofu in miso soup as my child only eats that (while traveling) and person taking ordered seemed lost. And what l got is half a cup of soup with maybe 4 pieces of tofu- but it was delicious. It goes downhill from that- I asked if goyzo can be steamed instead of pan fried (which is standard across world/countries I have tried- and again explained that that is how my child eat it. Anyone who has kids may understand). I was told,"No changes in menu" and he snatched menu and said, "you done ordering "? Oh well. Seat in looked good- and suchi looked good BUT I left felt cheated!

Nicely presented, good size portions and full of flavour. Nice cocktails too. Reasonable prices and great value. I often say in reviews that we would return. This is somewhere we definitely WILL return. Only point on atmosphere. I liked the music but it didn't quite match the venue. Probably aimed at younger folks, which judging by the hundreds of positive post it messages round the walls are the main clientele.

When we explained we didn’t eat fish and were vegan, we were told it was vegetarian (which is obviously isn’t). We explained it wasn’t and the food was remade but there was still fish flakes on the table after and we were left feeling distrustful and a bit sick. Neither of us could finish our food. When the waitress came to take our plates and ask if it was okay, we explained what had happened and said we weren’t happy, yet we were still charged full price for the meal. We won’t be coming here again and will be getting in touch with customer services.

The menma was good, the noodles were well cooked, but the chasui was not great, and I'm not sure why crispy onions were on the bowl. It was okay overall. I also had some chicken gyoza, which were tasty but slightly cold. The dipping sauce also just tasted like plain say sauce, which was a bit of a disappointment. Service was fast and friendly.

reviews.author: Mohammed Rahman
reviews.text: First time visiting with my siblings, we brought in drinks from outside, as we didn’t see the sign on the outside saying no drinks from outside. We were told this by the staff which we understood, we put the drinks away after being told and didn’t bring them out after. However if you are going to impose this rule then at least bring out the water we requested when we ordered the meal. All our food came out but the water didn’t. Lacking in customer servicing when you were happy to tell us to put the drinks away but we’re not providing us water when asked during order taking. Nonetheless the food was good the sushi was nice and the beef ramen was good, the chicken however was bland. Looking at other reviews, I can see people had similar issues. Atmosphere is nice and calm, chill and the decor is beautiful, especially the post stick note wall.

reviews.text: Gyan was fantastic!

reviews.author: Natasha On
reviews.text: Great food! Amazing service Gyan was lovely!

reviews.author: Natalia Almeida
reviews.text: Everything was so delicious! Loved the handrolls and sashimi. The sushi platter was sensational, genuinely no notes I was so obsessed. Deffo recommend going! I’d recommend the Akami Tuna Crudo, Tokyotini, Negi Toro Temaki, Omakase set and the new cocktail (Jada’s one! Shout out to her for amazing service)

reviews.author: GAMZE Oral
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I ate the best sushi I've ever had there. The night before, they said there were no tables available, but maybe half an hour, so they let us try it as a complimentary item. The second night, when they saw us, our selection had been enriched, and we received the day's special as a gift. Above all, they were incredibly hospitable. They greeted each of us individually. I think I'll miss this place the most in London 😍 (Original) Hayatumda yediğim en güzel susshi yi orada yedim.Bir önceki gece yer yok ama belki yarım saat dediler bekleyip gittik diye hediye deneme yaptırdılar. İkinci gece bizi gördüklerinde ise yaptığımız seçim zenginleştirilmişti ve günün speciali bize hediye geldi. Herşey bir yana çok misafirperverdiler. Tek tek hoşgeldiniz dediler. Londra da en çok burayı özleyeceğim sanırın😍

reviews.author: Anastasia Volsko
reviews.text: Wandering before a show at Phoenix Theater and happened upon them. The smoke and age their own salmon and have some great hand rolls. The service was great.

reviews.author: nirvana Nirvana
reviews.text: It was my first time visiting Maki Nori, and the omakase experience was truly outstanding. I’ve had omakase in many places—including Japan—and I can easily say this was one of my absolute favorites! The food was exceptionally fresh and delicious, set inside a cozy restaurant with a vibrant atmosphere. A special mention to the General Manager Ginger, what a lovely person! He is incredibly knowledgeable about Japanese cuisine, highly professional, and so friendly. I highly recommend this spot and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Vincent Lao
reviews.text: First meal eating out after being away from London. Finally back to having one of my favourite Asian food, Japanese 🍣 We ordered their: - Chef's selection 15 pcs Omakase - 5 Hand Rolls Sets - Black Dragon (Eel) Roll - Snow Crab California Roll - Wagu Truffle Maki Roll - Chef's Ceviche - Prawn Tempera - Grilled Aubergene

reviews.author: Payton Godlewski
reviews.text: I had such an amazing time here! The sushi is super high-quality and fairly affordable as well. One of the sushi chefs, Victoria, took the time to tell us all about where they sourced the fish and chat about her experience as a sushi chef! Couldn’t recommend this place more! Best sushi in London!!

reviews.author: Huw Siddle
reviews.text: The food was delicious and very interesting - the Tokusei menu was simple but very tasty, and the crudo and roll menus provided some interesting more out-there options, but the service was the highlight by far. Victoria specifically took the time out of her prep to answer a lot of our questions about the dishes and where they come from, which was absolutely above and beyond!

reviews.author: Arianna Leardini
reviews.text: What a surprise, this little restaurant has some really fantastic dishes. The “Crudo” are my favourites but the fried chicken too. Staff very professional and friendly, first time I tried Sake and the Jinger guy has great recommendations.

reviews.author: Olimpia Bernasconi
reviews.text: Impressive venue, very minimal but stylish!! The food is spectacular and tasty, the service refined and caring! The guy with the big moustaches definitely knows the menu, and can definitely give you some good advices. Great sake selection too!!! I will be back for more!!!

reviews.author: wing in lee
reviews.text: The chef is amazing, all the ingredients are very fresh

reviews.author: Zoe Chater
reviews.text: So yummy! Food is amazing and the cocktails are so good too

reviews.author: Ellie Danemann
reviews.text: Literally 10/10 cannot recommend enough!!

reviews.author: Nikita Patel
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in the service we received. We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come. One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us. The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority. We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained. Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend. DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.
